name: Software Developer
desc: Designs, writes, tests, and maintains applications, web services, and digital software solutions.
desc_te: అప్లికేషన్లు, వెబ్‌సైట్లు మరియు సాఫ్ట్‌వేర్ ఉత్పత్తులను కోడింగ్ ద్వారా నిర్మించి నిర్వహించే సాంకేతిక నిపుణులు.
verified_education_pathways: B.Tech / B.E. in Computer Science or IT (4 years)
BCA (Bachelor of Computer Applications, 3 years) followed by MCA
Polytechnic Diploma in Computer Engineering (3 years) + Lateral B.Tech entry
Self-directed portfolio learning via FreeCodeCamp, Odin Project, and SWAYAM CS courses
eligibility_conditions: 10+2 with Mathematics/Physics for engineering degree; direct admission in BCA/B.Sc CS across state colleges.
free_learning_alternatives: SWAYAM / NPTEL Computer Science courses by IIT Madras
FreeCodeCamp Responsive Web & JavaScript Foundations
CS50 Introduction to Computer Science (Harvard OpenCourseWare)
scholarship_opportunities: AICTE Pragati Scholarship for Girl Students (₹50,000/yr)
study_duration: 3 to 4 years (degree) or 6–12 months (intensive portfolio learning)
starter_projects: Student Task & Attendance Tracker with Local Storage
Weather & Crop Commodity Price Web App with Free REST API
roadmap_milestones: Understand developer workflows and terminal basics
Learn core programming foundations (loops, functions, data structures)
Build interactive frontend pages with semantic HTML and CSS
Construct a full-stack CRUD application with database persistence
Contribute to an open-source tool and push code to GitHub
Research junior roles, tech internships, and off-campus hiring drives

name: UI/UX & Product Designer
desc: Crafts accessible, intuitive, and visually engaging interfaces for digital applications.
desc_te: మొబైల్ మరియు వెబ్ యాప్‌లను సులభంగా, అందంగా ఉపయోగించేలా డిజైన్ చేసే నిపుణులు.
verified_education_pathways: Bachelor of Design (B.Des in Interaction/Communication Design, 4 years)
Degree in Visual Arts, Psychology, or Computer Science
Self-directed portfolio learning with Figma Community and Google UX Design Certificate
eligibility_conditions: 10+2 from any recognized stream (Science, Commerce, Arts); design aptitude test for top institutes.
free_learning_alternatives: Interaction Design Foundation Open Guides
Figma YouTube Tutorials & UI Design Sandbox
Open Accessibility Audits with WCAG Guidelines
starter_projects: Local Bus Transit App Redesign for Rural Commuters
Farmer Market Commodity Price Interface Audit
roadmap_milestones: Study daily apps and document usability frustrations
Master Figma layout grids, component states, and design tokens
Conduct user interviews with 3 real users on an everyday task
Publish a comprehensive Figma case study documenting decisions
Assemble a personal web portfolio explaining design rationale

name: Agricultural Scientist & Agronomist
desc: Improves crop yield, soil health, and climate resilience through agricultural biotechnology and smart farming.
desc_te: పంట దిగుబడిని పెంచడం, నేల సారాన్ని రక్షించడం మరియు నూతన వ్యవసాయ పద్ధతులను పరిశోధించే నిపుణులు.
typical_workstyle: Hands-on Practical (Physical lab, clinical, or field work)
verified_education_pathways: B.Sc (Hons) Agriculture / Horticulture (4 years accredited by ICAR)
B.Tech in Agricultural Engineering (4 years)
Diploma in Agriculture (2–3 years) + Lateral B.Sc entry
M.Sc in Agronomy / Soil Science for research positions
eligibility_conditions: 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry, Biology/Mathematics or Agriculture stream.
free_learning_alternatives: ICAR Agricultural Education Portal (Free Courseware)
SWAYAM Agronomy and Organic Farming Courses
Kisan Call Centre & Krishi Vigyan Kendra Extension Bulletins
scholarship_opportunities: Post-Matric Scholarships for Rural Farmers' Children
starter_projects: Village Soil Quality & Water pH Testing Logbook
Organic Pesticide Cost vs Yield Comparison Study
roadmap_milestones: Understand seasonal crop patterns and regional soil classifications
Complete 10+2 PCB or Agriculture stream prerequisites
Enroll in an ICAR-accredited State Agricultural University
Participate in Rural Agricultural Work Experience (RAWE)
Conduct field trial experiments on climate-resilient seeds

name: Solar Energy & Electrical Technician
desc: Installs, tests, and repairs rooftop solar panels, inverters, storage batteries, and residential electrical wiring.
desc_te: సౌర విద్యుత్ ప్యానెల్స్, ఇన్వర్టర్లు మరియు గృహ విద్యుత్ వ్యవస్థలను అమర్చే నిపుణులు.
typical_workstyle: Hands-on Practical (Physical lab, clinical, or field work)
verified_education_pathways: ITI Certificate in Electrician / Wireman (2 years)
Suryamitra Skill Development Program (Govt subsidized, 3 months)
Polytechnic Diploma in Electrical Engineering (3 years)
eligibility_conditions: Class 10 pass with Science and Mathematics.

estimated_education_cost_inr.self_taught_open_route: ₹0 (Skill India Digital Hub Suryamitra Free Modules)

free_learning_alternatives: Skill India Digital Hub Solar PV Installer modules
National Institute of Solar Energy (NISE) Free Guidelines
Bharat Skills ITI Electrician Question Bank
scholarship_opportunities: State Directorate of Training ITI Stipend
starter_projects: Design a 1kW Off-Grid Rooftop Solar Load Calculation Plan
Wiring Schematic for Domestic Solar Inverter Backup
roadmap_milestones: Complete Class 10 with strong physics foundations
Join a recognized Govt ITI or Suryamitra training center
Gain hands-on certification in high-voltage electrical safety
Complete 300 hours of rooftop installation apprenticeship
Register as a certified installer on the National Solar Rooftop Portal

name: Clinical Nurse & Healthcare Specialist
desc: Delivers patient care, administers clinical medications, monitors vitals, and assists medical doctors in hospitals.
desc_te: రోగులకు చికిత్స, మందులు మరియు వైద్య సేవలను అందించే వృత్తి.
typical_workstyle: Hands-on Practical (Physical lab, clinical, or field work)
verified_education_pathways: B.Sc Nursing (4 years course recognized by Indian Nursing Council)
GNM (General Nursing and Midwifery, 3 years diploma)
ANM (Auxiliary Nurse Midwife, 2 years for rural clinics)
eligibility_conditions: 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry, Biology and English with minimum 45% aggregate.
free_learning_alternatives: World Health Organization (WHO) Open Clinical Safety Modules
SWAYAM Basics of Health Sciences
St John Ambulance First Aid Digital Certification
scholarship_opportunities: Post-Matric Scholarship for Girls in Nursing
Central Sector Scheme of Scholarships for College Students
starter_projects: Create a Patient Vital Signs Charting Simulation
Compile a Standard Rural Clinic Sanitation Checklist
roadmap_milestones: Score 50%+ in 10+2 PCB subjects
Clear state nursing entrance examination
Undergo hospital clinical rotations across ICU, pediatrics, and surgery
Register with State Nursing Council as Registered Nurse (RN/RM)
Pursue specialized certifications (Critical Care, Oncology)

name: Data Analyst & Business Intelligence
desc: Analyzes raw numbers and company metrics using SQL, Python, and dashboards to guide strategic decisions.
desc_te: గణాంకాలు మరియు సమాచారాన్ని విశ్లేషించి వ్యాపార నిర్ణయాలకు తోడ్పడే నిపుణులు.
verified_education_pathways: B.Sc in Statistics, Mathematics, or Data Science (3 years)
B.Com with Computer Applications or BBA Analytics (3 years)
B.Tech in Computer Science / IT (4 years)
Google Data Analytics Certificate + Portfolio on Kaggle
free_learning_alternatives: SWAYAM Data Analytics with Python (IIT Roorkee)
Kaggle Free Micro-Courses in Python, Pandas, and SQL
Microsoft Power BI Official Community Training
starter_projects: Analysis of Public State Bus Transport Efficiency using Open Data
District Health Center Medicine Inventory Dashboard in Excel/SQL
roadmap_milestones: Master spreadsheet functions, pivot tables, and conditional formatting
Learn relational database design and write multi-table SQL joins
Create an interactive dashboard with clear KPI metrics in Power BI
Clean dirty datasets with Python Pandas and document insights
Publish 2 analytical case studies on GitHub or Kaggle

name: High School STEM Teacher
desc: Educates secondary school students in Mathematics, Science, and Social Studies, preparing them for higher studies.
desc_te: పాఠశాల విద్యార్థులకు గణితం మరియు సైన్స్ బోధించే నిపుణులు.
typical_workstyle: Highly Social (Team discussions, presenting, client interaction)
verified_education_pathways: B.Sc followed by Bachelor of Education (B.Ed, 2 years)
4-year Integrated B.Sc-B.Ed (ITEP under NEP 2020)
Mandatory Central/State Teacher Eligibility Test (CTET / TET) qualification
eligibility_conditions: Bachelor's degree with minimum 50% marks + B.Ed from an NCTE-recognized institution.
free_learning_alternatives: DIKSHA National Portal for School Education
NCERT Exemplar and Curriculum Training Modules
SWAYAM Pedagogical Courses for Secondary Teachers
starter_projects: Prepare a 5-Day Interactive Lesson Plan on Gravity with Real Experiments
Create a Bilingual (English-Telugu) Science Glossary for Rural Students
roadmap_milestones: Complete Bachelor's degree in your chosen subject stream
Enroll in an NCTE-approved B.Ed program
Complete mandatory 16-week classroom student teaching internship
Clear CTET Paper II (Upper Primary / High School)
Apply to State Teacher Recruitment or Central Schools (KVS/NVS)

name: Chartered Accountant & Financial Auditor
desc: Audits corporate accounts, manages direct/indirect tax compliance, and advises on financial management.
desc_te: పన్నులు, ఆడిటింగ్ మరియు కంపెనీల ఆర్థిక లావాదేవీలను నిర్వహించే ప్రొఫెషనల్.
verified_education_pathways: ICAI Foundation Course (after 10+2) → Intermediate → 2-year Articleship → CA Final
Direct Entry Scheme for Commerce Graduates with 55%+ marks
Concurrent B.Com degree alongside professional ICAI examinations
eligibility_conditions: 10+2 in any stream; registration with Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI).

estimated_education_cost_inr.government_route: ₹35,000 - ₹60,000 total ICAI registration fees over 4 years
estimated_education_cost_inr.self_taught_open_route: ₹35,000 (ICAI official study material is provided upon registration)

free_learning_alternatives: ICAI BoS Knowledge Portal (Free Live Lectures & Modules)
SWAYAM Accountancy & Tax Basics
Income Tax Department e-Filing Tutorials
starter_projects: Prepare a Sample GST Return Filing Sheet for a Local Kirana Store
Create a Personal Income Tax Calculator with New vs Old Tax Regime Comparison
roadmap_milestones: Register for ICAI CA Foundation after Class 12 exams
Clear Foundation examination and enroll in CA Intermediate
Complete 4 weeks of Information Technology & Soft Skills Training (ICITSS)
Complete 2 years of practical articleship under a practicing CA firm
Clear CA Final Examination and obtain ICAI Membership

typical_workstyle: Hands-on Practical (Physical lab, clinical, or field work)

Polytechnic Diploma in Civil Engineering (3 years) + Lateral Entry B.Tech
M.Tech in Structural / Transportation Engineering for senior consulting

BIS (Bureau of Indian Standards) Construction Code Summaries

Draft a 2-Story Residential Structural Floor Plan in CAD

name: Rural Banking & Microfinance Officer
desc: Facilitates agricultural credit, Self-Help Group (SHG) micro-loans, and financial literacy in rural communities.
desc_te: గ్రామీణ స్వయం సహాయక సంఘాలు మరియు రైతులకు బ్యాంకింగ్ రుణాలు మరియు ఆర్థిక సేవలను అందించే వృత్తి.
typical_workstyle: Highly Social (Team discussions, presenting, client interaction)
verified_education_pathways: Bachelor's degree in any discipline (B.Com, B.A., BBA, B.Sc)
Institute of Banking Personnel Selection (IBPS) RRB Exam qualification
Diploma in Rural Development / Microfinance
eligibility_conditions: Bachelor's degree from any recognized university; proficiency in local state language (e.g. Telugu).
relevant_entrance_exams: IBPS RRB (Regional Rural Banks) Scale I & Office Assistant

estimated_education_cost_inr.self_taught_open_route: ₹0 (RBI Financial Literacy material + IBPS syllabus online)

free_learning_alternatives: Reserve Bank of India (RBI) Financial Education Guides
NABARD Microfinance and SHG Bank Linkage Publications
SWAYAM Rural Development Courses
starter_projects: Conduct a Financial Literacy Survey of 10 Rural Households
Map Loan Repayment Cycles for a Local Farmer Produce Group
roadmap_milestones: Complete recognized Bachelor's degree in any stream
Prepare for IBPS RRB Quantitative Aptitude, Reasoning, and Banking Awareness
Learn agricultural credit schemes (Kisan Credit Card, Mudra Loans)
Clear IBPS RRB Preliminary and Main examinations
Undergo Regional Rural Bank probationary officer training
